summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second, single-shot English-language performance. Under <Subject 2>'s silent gaze, <Subject 1> realizes her secret has been exposed. She tries to justify herself, stops hiding behind that explanation, admits what she did, and accepts responsibility while still afraid. <Picture 1> anchors the characters' positions, her identity, and the close composition.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain her face, hair, eyes, lips, and recognizable features as her expression changes.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain only his partial foreground presence and hand near her hairline. He remains silent and does not become a second speaker.
<Picture 1> (composition reference for [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the intimate eye line, foreground occlusion, warm lighting, and close framing. A push-in of no more than 5% begins only at the specified moment.

detailed_description:
One continuous 15-second close-up. The composition follows <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> faces the man just off-camera to the left, while <Subject 2>'s partial silhouette and hand remain in the foreground. The man gives no answer and keeps looking at her. The camera stays completely steady for the first eight seconds. Her performance develops through listening, breath, gaze, and restrained facial movement; she never turns toward the lens.

[Shot 1] From 0–4 seconds, <Subject 1>'s breath catches slightly under his silent gaze. Her eyes move down and to the side before her head follows; for a moment her gaze finds no stable point. Her head and neck draw inward a fraction, without exaggerated shoulder shaking. About half a second later, she looks up at him again, needing to read his reaction. She draws a small, silent breath. Her lips part, hesitate, and <Subject 1> (S1) asks very softly, with unsteady breath, <d>[English] You... know everything?</d> “You” is barely voiced. Leave about half a second of silence after it, as if she is making one last attempt to judge whether she can still conceal the truth. After speaking, she holds his gaze and blinks once, quickly, waiting for a reply.

From 4–8 seconds, <Subject 2> remains silent. Her prepared explanation falters. Her brows gather slightly and her mouth loses support. She swallows once, then briefly lowers her gaze toward the man's chest without bowing her head. Trying to keep a sob out of her voice, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[English] I just... didn't want you to get hurt.</d> “I just” comes a little quickly, as instinctive self-defense. After the pause, she speaks the rest more slowly; her breath grows shallow and the final sound narrows. Her chin trembles once, very slightly, and she immediately controls it. Her eyes begin to fill, but no tear falls.

From 8–11 seconds, she briefly catches her lower lip between her teeth and releases it. With her mouth closed, she takes a deeper breath; the movement in her chest is small. Her jaw firms for an instant. When she raises her eyes again, she is still frightened, but she no longer looks away. At the moment she decides to confess, the camera begins an extremely slow push-in of no more than 5%. All unnecessary movement stops as <Subject 1> (S1) says, low and clearly, <d>[English] But I was the one who did it.</d> She slows and stresses “I” without raising her voice. The push-in stops as the line ends. She closes her lips and offers no further explanation.

From 11–15 seconds, she looks directly into the man's eyes. Her eyes are visibly red and tears gather along the lower lids without running down her face. Her breathing still trembles slightly, but her neck no longer retreats. Her jaw remains controlled. <Subject 1> (S1) says, quietly, <d>[English] No matter what happens... I'll take responsibility myself.</d> The first clause is slow and still carries fear. Leave about half a second after “happens” for a short inhale. The final clause is clear and steady, with each word allowed to land rather than shouted. After the line, she stays silent and keeps looking at him. For roughly the final second she does not blink or look away; her lips close gently as she waits for his response. Fear remains visible in her wet eyes and imperfectly steady breath.

overall_soundscape:
A quiet, close interior ambience with the woman's natural breaths, one swallow, and subtle clothing movement. All dialogue is spoken in English by <Subject 1> (S1), with accurate lip synchronization and one consistent voice. <Subject 2> gives no spoken reply. No audible sobbing outburst or added effects.
